citation: James S. Buck, Pioneer History of Milwaukee, vol. 1 (Milwaukee, 1876), biographical notice of Alanson Sweet.
author: James S. Buck
locator: vol. 1, biographical notice of Alanson Sweet
note: States that Sweet came from Owasco, New York in 1835 and had worked his stone-mason trade in early Chicago. This corroborates the Chicago identity and a 1835 move to Milwaukee, but the reviewed passage gives no safe departure date relative to July 1.
